alerts.title: Probable EFV Neuropsychiatric Adverse Effect: Insomnia and Vivid Dreams
alerts.message: Guidelines state EFV frequently causes neuropsychiatric effects, typically insomnia, vivid dreams and dizziness, most commonly within the first 2-6 weeks of therapy. Patient has been on EFV since February 2024 (about 23 months) and now reports several weeks of poor sleep and vivid dreams, which is later than the typical onset window, so attribution to EFV is less certain. Non-drug causes such as stress, mood disorder or sleep disorder should be considered. Guidelines also require screening for suicidality with persistent neuropsychiatric symptoms; the patient denies suicidal ideation today.

evidence.recommended_action: Assess for persistent EFV neuropsychiatric toxicity and screen for mood/anxiety disorders using a validated instrument (e.g. PHQ-9, GAD-7). If symptoms are persistent and attributable to EFV, consider switching to an alternative agent per local guidelines, with repeat suicidality assessment.
